item.text: I’ll record a decision for each supplied profile based only on the evidence provided, then verify the submission status.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc './submit_profile "Rosalie Viney" accept "Exact UTS affiliation and a coherent health-economics/EQ-5D valuation record.
